po_authorization_ref: Product-Owner clarified final Production requirement (T0080): PHYSICAL zero-superseded guest IAM. Repository-only; not Phase 8. Readiness restored only after verification, as directed.
previous_state_note: T0080 withdrew READY because the criterion it rested on had been superseded before any deployment.
new_state_note: The Zero-Legacy Fresh Production Baseline is COMPLETE and VERIFIED, so READY is restored. The superseded guest-IAM implementation and its tables are absent from the product, not merely unreachable: public went from 44 tables to 37, no foreign key references any removed object, and the IAM-v2 guest domain is the only one. Proven by factory-clean reconstruction from an empty isolated environment on the Production-equivalent image through the real Gate-P path.

edged: the guest-access-plans, voucher-batches, vouchers and payments operator surfaces; the superseded half of the guest-accounts surface; and the acctAuthority dispatch switch.
internal/session and internal/voucher: the superseded session and voucher domains, deleted.
hotel-admin: the Guest access plans, Voucher batches and Payments pages, their nav entries and their role-matrix rows.

retained_and_why.public.auth_otps: transient OTP CHALLENGE store. Per accepted decision D2 the challenge is verified upstream and only the verified factor crosses into iam_v2; delivery scaffolding, not an identity store. Its template_id column and FK were dropped.
retained_and_why.public.social_oauth_states: OAuth HANDSHAKE nonce store, same basis. template_id dropped: pinning an access plan at handshake time was the superseded coupling.
retained_and_why.public.social_oauth_providers: tenant provider configuration; never depended on the superseded set.
retained_and_why.public.otp_hmac_key_generations and auth: key generations and durable throttle state; current.
retained_and_why.public.accounting_records: TimescaleDB hypertable holding the historical accounting series. Phase-3 accounting writes iam_v2.accounting_records; destroying an accounting series is not a schema cleanup.
retained_and_why.platform foundations: tenants, sites, appliances, operators, operator_roles, guest_networks, networking, audit, enrolment/claim/signed-assignment and licensing: all intact and untouched.

defect_found_and_fixed: The site-wide LICENSED CONCURRENT-GUEST CAP existed only inside the superseded session manager, which owned session creation. Removing that manager would have removed the licence limit itself -- an unlicensed appliance that still works. It was moved into the IAM-v2 activation transaction (cmd/scd/iamv2_session_activate.go), counted in the same transaction that inserts, against the same local signed licence, refusing with LICENSE_CAPACITY_REACHED.
